Name: Microsoft365DefenderBeta-Microsoft 365 Defender - Incidents Connector
Author: admin
Description: Pull information about incidents and related alerts from Microsoft 365 Defender. Note: whitelist works with an incident name.

Parameters.Description: Describes the name of the field where the environment name is stored. If the environment field isn't found, the environment is the default environment.

A regex pattern to run on the value found in the "Environment Field Name" field. Default is .* to catch all and return the value unchanged. Used to allow the user to manipulate the environment field via regex logic. If the regex pattern is null or empty, or the environment value is null, the final environment result is the default environment.
Login API root of the Microsoft 365 Defender instance.
API root of the Microsoft Graph service.
API root of the Microsoft 365 Defender service.
Microsoft 365 Defender account tenant ID.
Microsoft 365 Defender account client ID.
Microsoft 365 Defender account client secret.
If enabled, verify the SSL certificate for the connection to the Microsoft 365 Defender server is valid.
Lowest severity that will be used to fetch incidents. Possible values: Informational, Low, Medium, High.

Number of hours before the first connector iteration to retrieve incidents from. This parameter applies to the initial connector iteration after you enable the connector for the first time, or used as a fallback value in cases where connector's last run timestamp expires.
How many incidents  to process per one connector iteration. Maximum is 20.
Field that can be used in the dynamic list for filtering. Possible values: Incident Name, Alert Name. If nothing is provided, connector will work with the incident name.

A comma-separated list of incident statuses that need to be ingested. If nothing is provided, the connector will ingest incidents with status “Active” and “In Progress”. Possible values:
Active, In Progress, Resolved, Redirected.
Note: it’s not recommended to ingest redirected incidents, because in most situations they will be empty.

A comma-separated list of detection sources of alerts that need to be ingested. Note: this is a case sensitive parameter. Example of the values:
antivirus, microsoftDefenderForEndpoint

A comma-separated list of service sources of alerts that need to be ingested. Note: this is a case sensitive parameter. Example of the values:
antivirus, microsoftDefenderForEndpoint
If enabled, whitelist will be used as a blacklist.
If enabled, connector will ignore the overflow mechanism.
Lowest severity that will be used to fetch alerts. Possible values: Informational, Low, Medium, High.
If enabled, the connector will stop tracking updates associated with alerts.
The address of the proxy server to use.
The proxy username to authenticate with.
The proxy password to authenticate with.
